newValue.text: Room building: no visible guidance on required room combination for a mission order
Contractor bonuses are shown at signup but their effect is invisible during mission
Francs economy is undefined - players have no sense of what it is or its value
Mining order panel: players must know which mineral to collect without clear in-world signposting
Debrief resolution is unclear - what does Resolve mean and what am I getting?
Mission 5 contractor offer arrives with no narrative context explaining what changed
Science data connection is buried - TESS/asteroid provenance is not shown on the target card
